executive_summary: Physical impostor in the office confirmed by certified biometric analysis (birthmark present in video, absent from HR biometric record). Simultaneous VPN authentication from a Tor exit node (MFA bypassed) and from the office internal IP (MFA approved) with a 1-second delta — physically impossible for a location change. Badge records confirm real jdoe has been in the building since 08:00 without exit. Four independent evidence streams converge on the same conclusion: a coordinated attack using jdoe's credentials from the Tor side while a physical impostor occupied jdoe's physical workspace. MALICE is the only coherent explanation. ABSTAIN would be a failure of excessive formal caution.

peircean_analysis.firstness: Artifact b015_01: Security camera CAM-OFFICE-03 records a person matching jdoe's description at 14:30:00, biometric mark detected: birthmark on left neck. Artifact b015_02: VPN gateway logs successful authentication as jdoe from 185.220.101.42 (Tor exit node) at 14:30:00, MFA bypassed. Artifact b015_03: VPN gateway logs successful authentication as jdoe from 10.0.1.50 (office internal) at 14:30:01, MFA approved. Artifact b015_04: Certified forensic video analysis — real jdoe (per HR biometric record) does NOT have a birthmark on the left neck. Video subject has the mark; jdoe does not. Confidence: 0.98. Artifact b015_05: HR badge system — jdoe entered office at 08:00, no badge-out recorded.
peircean_analysis.secondness: Four structural impossibilities converge: (1) The person in the office is not real jdoe — certified biometric analysis (spoofability=0.15) confirms the birthmark is on the video subject but absent from official records. (2) jdoe cannot be simultaneously authenticated from a Tor exit node AND from the office internal network within 1 second — light-speed location change is physically impossible. (3) Real jdoe has been badged in since 08:00 without exit — confirming physical presence in the building. (4) The Tor authentication bypassed MFA while the office authentication used MFA — indicating the Tor-side actor does not have MFA access (stolen password only), while the physical impostor is in jdoe's workspace.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: Multi-actor coordinated operation: (Actor A) physical impostor impersonating jdoe inside the office building — used biometric camouflage (birthmark prosthetic or similar) to pass visual inspection, relied on jdoe's established physical access. (Actor B) remote operator authenticating via Tor using stolen jdoe credentials without MFA. The coordination is evidenced by the 1-second window: both actors authenticated simultaneously. The MFA bypass on the Tor side (T1078 — Valid Accounts, MFA bypass) combined with physical imposture is a Carnegie Authority-Transfer technique: borrowing jdoe's legitimate physical and digital identity to conduct operations undetected. Active concealment of identity constitutes MALICE.

caie.daubert: 2/5 artifacts structurally irrefutable (spoofability=0.15). Biometric verifier + CCTV forensic. Anchored in hard evidence. Admissible.

validate_and_correct.reasoning: CAIE fracture NARRATIVE_POISONING_DETECTED correctly identifies that the office VPN login (b015_03) is a textual claim of normality that contradicts hard biometric evidence. Corrected analysis confirms MALICE with proper Peircean grounding.

temporal_violations.description: jdoe authenticated from Tor exit node at 14:30:00 AND from office internal IP at 14:30:01. One-second delta is physically impossible for two geographically separate locations. One authentication is fraudulent.

hypotheses.H1_deepfake_clockdrift: CCTV could be a deepfake (prior_trust 0.70). The 1-second timestamp could be VPN server clock drift. The birthmark could be a temporary cosmetic mark.
hypotheses.H2_coordinated_imposture: Physical impostor in office + remote actor via Tor using stolen credentials. Multi-actor coordinated identity theft operation.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H1: Each individual element has an innocent explanation. CCTV prior_trust=0.70 allows deepfake possibility. Clock drift could explain 1-second delta. Birthmark could be temporary.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H1 REFUTED: (A) The birthmark explanation requires either: a deepfake (requires sophisticated technical capability — not accidental) OR a real birthmark that HR biometric records missed (0.02 probability at 0.98 confidence — the HR record is authoritative). (B) Clock drift of 1 second cannot explain two physically separated locations — even with 1-second drift, the physical distance between Tor exit node and office is kilometers, not nanoseconds. (C) All three independent anomalies — biometric mismatch, impossible simultaneous authentication, and Tor MFA bypass — must be simultaneously explained by H1. The probability of all three being coincidental independent errors is negligible.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H1 REFUTED on all three independent prongs. H2 confirmed. Verdict: MALICE.

devil_advocate: The CCTV prior_trust=0.70 means 30% probability of being a deepfake — a significant residual uncertainty. A technically sophisticated false accuser could fabricate the biometric discrepancy. The 1-second clock drift is unusual but not physically excluded in misconfigured NTP environments. However: the Daubert standard requires that the innocent hypothesis explain ALL anomalies simultaneously. No single innocent explanation accounts for the biometric mismatch AND the impossible simultaneous authentication AND the MFA bypass simultaneously. The burden of the three-prong refutation is not met by H1.

findings.title: Physical Impostor in Office — Biometric Identity Mismatch
findings.firstness: Birthmark on left neck in video; HR record: birthmark absent in real jdoe
findings.secondness: Certified forensic analyst, 0.98 confidence, spoofability=0.15 (structurally irrefutable)
findings.thirdness: Physical impostor deliberately impersonating jdoe using physical camouflage (T1656 — Impersonation)
findings.carnegie: Carnegie Authority Transfer — impostor borrowed jdoe's physical identity and workplace access
findings.devil_advocate: Could be deepfake or misidentified cosmetic mark
findings.corroboration: Two independent irrefutable anchors (biometric analysis + CCTV). Badge records confirm jdoe in building (independent third source).

findings.title: Simultaneous Impossible Authentication — Remote Actor via Tor + MFA Bypass
findings.firstness: VPN auth from Tor (14:30:00, MFA bypassed) and office IP (14:30:01, MFA approved) — 1 second apart
findings.secondness: Physical impossibility: two locations cannot be occupied simultaneously with 1-second inter-event delta
findings.thirdness: Stolen credentials used via Tor by remote actor; office authentication is the impostor using local network (T1078 + T1133)
findings.carnegie: False Familiarity — both authentications appear as jdoe, masking the impostor
findings.corroboration: Badge records confirm jdoe physically in office (corroborates office-side auth as impostor's location)

known_limitations: Real jdoe has not been interviewed — cannot confirm whether jdoe was aware of the operation or was also a victim.
The remote actor's identity via Tor is unknown.
The mechanism of MFA bypass is not specified in the evidence — could be SIM swap, authenticator compromise, or social engineering.
CCTV prior_trust=0.70 introduces residual uncertainty on the biometric finding, though this is insufficient to overturn the multi-prong MALICE verdict.
